observed_failure: No formal authority hierarchy existed between the write-ahead transaction log and derived consensus state, allowing silent divergence or ambiguous authority during partition recovery.
canonical_invariant_violated: TRANSACTION_LOG_CONSENSUS_COHERENCE: The transaction log is the primary authoritative source of truth; consensus state is a derived projection. Any divergence must immediately trigger fail-closed ConsensusLogDivergenceError.
root_cause: Consensus view and WAL maintained separate state transitions without cryptographic anti-entropy cross-validation.
contributing_causes: Lack of periodic checkpoint log-hash vs consensus-hash coherence verification
existing_behavior: Consensus state and transaction log operate with independent state checks.
required_behavior: Transaction log establishes primacy; periodic verify_log_consensus_coherence compares log head hash with consensus replay; divergence raises ConsensusLogDivergenceError and halts write admission.
implementation_scope: Raise ConsensusLogDivergenceError when state hashes diverge
planned_fix: Establish Transaction Log primacy and add cryptographic cross-validation with fail-closed divergence exception.
planned_negative_control: Inject mismatched consensus checkpoint hash; verify ConsensusLogDivergenceError is raised and writes are blocked.
planned_causal_ablation: Ignore divergence; verify test detects failure to fail-closed.
